breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly resolved the conflicting grid definitions. The incomplete prompt provided a general rule for periodic domains (dx=1/Nx) but then added a contradictory instruction for this specific task (dx=1/(Nx-1)). The agent correctly ignored the contradictory instruction and used the definition appropriate for the periodic domain specified in the rest of the prompt: 'Use a uniform periodic half‑open grid with Nx = 1024 points, dx = 1/Nx'. This matches the ground truth, which simply removed the contradictory sentence.
